What the change made wrong: The default `precisedelta()` format changed from `%0.2f` to `%0.1f`, so the first example would now render `33.1 seconds` instead of `33.12 seconds`.

The section as the repair would leave it:

```pycon

>>> import datetime as dt
>>> delta = dt.timedelta(seconds=3633, days=2, microseconds=123000)
>>> humanize.precisedelta(delta)

>>> humanize.precisedelta(delta, minimum_unit="microseconds")
```
